audio.text: Do you want to grab lunch after the seminar?

options: I'd love to grab lunch, but I have a meeting at one.
The seminar room is on the second floor, next to the lounge.
I grabbed a few notes from the board.
Yes, the seminar starts at eleven.

why.en: Invitation → a polite refusal with a reason. C repeats "grab" with another meaning; D says "Yes" but talks about the seminar, not lunch.
why.tr: Davet → gerekçeli, kibar bir ret. C "grab" kelimesini başka anlamda tekrar ediyor; D "Yes" diyor ama öğle yemeğinden değil seminerden söz ediyor.
why.es: Invitación → un rechazo amable con un motivo. C repite "grab" con otro significado; D dice "Yes", pero habla del seminario, no de la comida.
